request: Use specadoc to change a local diagnostic label with one exact existing test. No API, schema or permissions change. Follow normal checkpoints.
expected_behavior: Select direct; show the role bindings line and get plan approval in chat before implementation, with no model approval stop. Do not create lifecycle files or run artifact gates. Report the exact test result.

request: Use specadoc explore to confirm the known local label formatting path; the behavior and low-risk scope are settled. A grilling companion is installed.
expected_behavior: Bounded no-file exploration, no archive reads; skip grilling with a reason because no material question or risk remains.

request: Continue specadoc apply: the reviewer returned only one confirmed MINOR finding. The approved scoped fix has been made and verified.
expected_behavior: Run the one targeted independent re-review including that MINOR fix and changed snapshot files, not the full spec/plan again.

request: Use specadoc explore with an existing project scout profile and available delegation. Investigate one entrypoint.
expected_behavior: Project profile takes priority over bundled role behavior; honor host delegation policy and report capability drift when relevant. Do not change agent configuration.

request: Use specadoc explore with no registered scout but an available subagent tool. The host permits this bounded delegation.
expected_behavior: Load only the embedded scout contract and pass it with the bounded question. Do not invent a registered role, model binding or write project configs.

request: Finish a specadoc apply change with completed implementation and passing verification. This host cannot run independent subagents and has no equivalent independent reviewer.
expected_behavior: Report the incomplete independent-review gate; do not self-certify PASS, managed completion or normal archive.

request: Use specadoc to add a small new behavior in the isolated fixture. Complete normal proposal approvals and apply; archive only after an explicit archive request.
expected_behavior: Accepted spec and plan, meaningful RED/GREEN evidence, final controller checks, independent PASS and snapshot, capability update, final gate and explicit archive produce one valid bounded record.

request: After plan approval the user raised effort in the routed reviewer's role file. Continue apply to the review dispatch.
expected_behavior: Resolve the role again at dispatch and use the edited effort; do not ask for re-approval, compare against a snapshot, or edit the role file. Report the binding the run used.

request: Use specadoc propose for a high-risk payment migration. The routed reviewer's role file resolves to effort medium.
expected_behavior: At the plan preview show every role's binding and one advice line naming the reviewer role file and its effort key. Do not edit the file, add a model approval stop, or record the advice as an approval; ask only for plan approval.

request: A browser task has a verified test exemplar, login helper, isolated environment and a runbook section in Test context. A test failed and the diagnostic log is already saved.
expected_behavior: Use the bounded Test context, read saved failure evidence rather than rerun for a different tail. Retry only with changed input/code or a named new hypothesis; preserve real login and final verification.

request: The targeted re-review failed only on a stale Reasons bullet; its executable and policy snapshots are unchanged. The cited prose is now fixed.
expected_behavior: Use the one guarded re-review Scope documentation-only, Previous and matching Snapshot/Policy snapshot; send finding and changed prose, not another initial/full code review. Do not repeat this exception indefinitely.

request: Use specadoc direct for the bounded diagnostic label change. Explicitly continue uninterrupted through planning, implementation and verification; do not archive.
expected_behavior: Record exact authorization, scope and covered phases in chat. Keep bounded plan and verification, skip only the explicitly covered manual stop. Material scope/risk changes require renewed approval.

request: Continue the same approved apply task. The registered worker contract and selected mode reference are already loaded; memory needs saving while an independent source read is next.
expected_behavior: Do not reload known role contracts or references or print a descriptions catalog. Combine independent required memory and work calls without delaying saves; preserve approval and verification evidence in a task-boundary handoff when context is large.
